text:
Sam W: Heads up - AcmeOps wants a short POC to validate enterprise auth flows before contract. Scope they asked for: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (group sync), RBAC mapping to AD groups, and domain ownership verification. Also they want short-term Dedicated capacity for load testing and audit logs. Can we run through blockers and quick pricing?

Judy - Sales: Thanks - they pushed this as a gating item for legal. Key asks from their side: 1) 3-week POC window, 250k tokens/day simulated, 2) SCIM create/update/delete + group sync to map roles, 3) SAML role assertion named `enterpriseRole`, 4) audit logs export to S3, 5) domain claim verification for *.acme.com.

Devon K: I can own the SAML/SCIM mapping. Question: do they expect SCIM to provision nested groups? Their IDM (Okta) uses nested groups heavily which affects RBAC mapping.

Rachel (SE): We support nested group sync but need to confirm whether they want direct group->role mapping or allow a mapping table (group regex -> role). For POC, recommend a 1:1 mapping to keep acceptance criteria simple. Acceptance tests we should run: create user, add to group, verify role assigned and token includes role claim; deprovision user -> no access.

Sam W: Good point. Judy - will legal accept 3-week Dedicated eval or do they need private deployment? They mentioned compliance but seemed fine with dedicated if logs/SLA are intact.

Judy - Sales: Customer prefers Dedicated for predictability. They asked for a price estimate for a 3-week Dedicated slot + audit logs export. They're ok with an add-on for longer term. Can we get a one-line cost estimate (+ any minimums)?

Rachel (SE): Quick estimate: Dedicated (small reserved pool) pro-rated ~ $6k/week -> $18k for 3 weeks. Audit logs export add-on ~ $500 flat for setup + $0.10/GB. Also factor in an engineering kickoff (2-4h) and SAML metadata exchange. Can make this a provisional quote.

Devon K: Tech blockers: 1) SAML assertion nameId format - they send transient; we need persistent. Ask them to switch to email or persistent ID. 2) SCIM: their Okta schema uses `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User` for employeeNumber. We'll map but need example payload. 3) Domain verification: we support DNS TXT or email route; they prefer automated DNS TXT.

Sam W: I'll ask them for sample SAML metadata and a SCIM example payload. Also request Okta admin invite so we can test provisioning against their sandbox.

Judy - Sales: Legal/security questionnaire - they flagged data residency + KMS integration. We can offer logs to S3 in their account and integrate with customer KMS for encryption at rest. Add to checklist: SOC2 attestation, customer-managed KMS, retention window for logs.

Rachel (SE): POC deliverables (what we'll commit):
- SAML metadata import and verification (assertion contains `enterpriseRole`)
- SCIM group sync working end-to-end (including nested groups demo)
- RBAC mapping doc + mapping table deployed in config
- Audit logs exported to their S3 + sample log events for user lifecycle
- Performance smoke test at target token/day on Dedicated pool

Devon K: Snippet for the SCIM group payload we'll test with (ask them to provide similar):
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],
  "displayName": "eng-product",
  "members": [{"value": "user-123", "display": "alice@example.com"}]
}
```

Rachel (SE): Next steps: Sam to gather SAML metadata + Okta admin invite + SCIM sample by EOD tomorrow. Judy to send provisional quote email with the $18k estimate + logs addon and the engineering kickoff time window. I'll prep the POC runbook and acceptance test checklist.

Sam W: On it. tagging @okta-bot for any automated hints :callout: 

okta-bot: (bot) If you add `okta-admin@acme.com` as a test admin to our sandbox org, I can create a sample SCIM app and export a sample payload.

Judy - Sales: Great - will CC legal for data residency note. Thanks team :thumbsup:
